sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: springsteenlyrics.com: the compact category and filter bar (WIP.2) now also runs on the bootleg main page, bootlegs.php. There it offers the Category menu with the era timeline (WIP.3), the bootleg search box and Recent (WIP.4). The page lists no items itself, so it gets no action button, and the toolbar keeps only ⚙️ and ❓. With the bar switched off, the script leaves that page alone.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: springsteenlyrics.com: once a list is loaded, the compact bar's Country, Year and Copies menus filter the loaded table instead of reloading the page, like a pick in that column's 📊 menu. The chip shows 📊, its × removes just that filter, and the bar follows the column when you clear it there instead. Format, Album and Category still open another list, and each menu says at the top which kind it is. A filter the list was fetched with still needs a reload, because the table holds nothing else.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: springsteenlyrics.com: a compact-bar menu opened while the bar sat low on the screen ran past the bottom of the window, and its last entries could not be reached. Menus now open upwards when there is more room above, and scroll inside when they are taller than the space they have.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: springsteenlyrics.com: with the compact bar (WIP.2) on, the bootleg lists' four search forms (date, title, version, public info) become one search box with a field switch: Auto, Date, Title, Version, Public info. Auto searches the date when you type one and titles otherwise. Dates can be typed as 1975-08-15, 15 Aug 1975, Aug 15, 1975 or 15.08.1975. A day that does not exist is pointed out instead of returning an empty list. The site finds full dates only, so for a month or a year (1975-08, Aug 1975, 1975) the box offers the era list that covers it and a title search instead. On a search's result page the box shows that search.
springsteenlyrics.com: a Recent menu beside the search box lists your last eight bootleg searches, including ones started from the site's own forms, and can forget them.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: springsteenlyrics.com: the compact category and filter bar (WIP.2) now also works on the bootleg lists, where the category buttons become a Category menu. Its setting is renamed "Compact category and filter bar on springsteenlyrics.com lists".

springsteenlyrics.com: the Category menu marks the list you are on (the bootleg lists' own buttons never did). Once you have opened a list with the bar on, it also shows that category's exact number of items, read from the list's own "Showing items … of N" line. A list you have not opened yet shows no number; nothing is estimated.

springsteenlyrics.com: on the bootleg lists the Category menu starts with a timeline of the live-show eras since 1967. Each bar spans its era's years, its height shows recordings per year, and an era you have not opened yet is drawn dashed with a "?". Click a bar to open that era.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: springsteenlyrics.com: a new setting, "Compact category and filter bar on springsteenlyrics.com collection pages" (off by default), replaces the collection's rows of category, format, country, album, year and copies buttons with one row of pull-down menus above the list. Each menu offers what that page's own buttons offer and marks the current choice. Long menus have a search box, and the menus work with the keyboard. Filters combine: choosing a country keeps the format you already chose. Each filter in use is shown as a chip whose × removes just that filter. The site's own buttons are only hidden, so switching the setting off brings them back.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: springsteenlyrics.com: every collection category now works, not just "Official Albums". On the other categories (Samplers, Singles, Books, Memorabilia, …) the button converted nothing, and the heading read just "Collection".

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: springsteenlyrics.com: the collection's entry page (collection.php, "Latest additions", the whole collection) is now supported, with a "Show all latest additions" button ("Items"). It has over 5000 items in more than 50 pages, so the usual "many pages" and "many rows" questions come first.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: springsteenlyrics.com: Title is now the sticky column instead of Cover, on collection and bootleg lists.

springsteenlyrics.com: with Enable Sticky Page Headers (📌 Table stickiness, on by default), everything above a wide table now stays in place while you scroll sideways. That covers the site's header and breadcrumb, the toolbar, the category and filter buttons, and the list's heading bar. The year-filter slider and the "Formats guide" panel no longer drift off to the right.
springsteenlyrics.com: when the script finds no item cards on a list page, it now writes a warning to the browser console instead of silently showing an empty table.
